The patch content and upstream preimage identity match exactly, and Windows Task 9 succeeds. The repair must use mature Git working-tree EOL materialization to present the unchanged exact patch files as CRLF on Linux before invoking the unchanged strict tools/matrix/bootstrap.js, then restore the repository working tree and require git-clean. No git-apply whitespace weakening, patch edit, bootstrap edit, dependency-manifest edit, or runtime/UI edit is authorized.
